scope: Expose the qualified contained ordinary-image exFAT root/system observer through the existing image.inspect identity and shared CLI/protocol/GUI/TUI/shell actions in the selected Windows image prototype. Original all-platform/storage0.1.0, complete exFAT names/tree/content/extraction and writer qualification remain required later work.
ownership: Existing runtime/capture owns ExfatInspectionRequest/Read/Port, validation, result projection and command outcomes; platform/windows/storage binds the owned reader; apps/disked composes it and the existing Windows entry dispatches its compiled role. Extend the canonical command schema/catalog and generator; do not create another command registry or scheduler.
invocation: image.inspect PATH --view exfat requires explicit decimal-u64 volume-offset and positive volume-bytes within the checked native source window. Preserve omitted/map/fat behaviour. Add upcase-format auto|compressed|literal, default auto for exfat. FAT-only controls and unrelated expected-revision/plan/provider flags are typed conflicts before source access. Static help/build/discovery/completion stays independent of source probing.
upcase_selection: Implement automatic table interpretation as part of this task, using the original retained table bytes within one source observation. Evaluate the compressed and literal candidates under bounded work/count/checksum/mandatory-ASCII rules. Select the sole valid candidate, or an equivalent map if both are valid and identical. If both are valid and differ, report explicit exfat_upcase_representation_ambiguous and confer no map/lookup applicability; an explicit representation is recorded and validated rather than silently preferred. Preserve original bytes and both candidate outcomes. Do not use host Unicode normalization or a guessed format from byte length alone.
format_basis: Microsoft's exFAT specification requires interpreting both compressed and uncompressed tables. Independent native probe evidence demonstrates that a 131072-byte table can validate both representations with different complete maps; ambiguity refusal is a derived rule, not a quoted format requirement. Exact probe/source identity is retained in .aide/evidence/2026-10-14-exfat-command-start/selection-expectations.json.
native_binding: Reuse the owned ExfatWorker and existing local_file/source-generation checks. Expected source metadata is checked before content reads. Synchronous native callback/owned session remains with its slot until actual process exit; frontend wait expiry yields unresolved state without replacement, dependency release or late unsolicited publication. No raw devices, elevation, mount, installation, output creation or source writes.
result: Versioned private root-and-active-system observation projection with source/window/representation facts, boot/root/bitmap/upcase findings, copied original record/region identities, actual owned process/code/request/capture context and separate retirement. Bound original complete observation/receipt by digests and expose explicit original/returned/omitted counts for detail within the existing 524288-byte command response ceiling. No whole tree, namespace equality, filesystem health, durable source access or storage ABI claim.
outcomes: Complete applicable root/system observations with measured source agreement yield completed0. Incomplete/unsupported/malformed metadata or resource-limited prefixes yield failed4 with specific media/coverage diagnostics and accurately scoped facts; source disagreement is a separate failed4 diagnostic. Invalid/conflicting command parameters yield refused2 before source access: CLI missing parameters use missing_parameter, CLI invalid values or schema relationships use invalid_option_value, and constructed service requests use invalid_parameter; native path/source-profile/unavailable-service refusals yield refused3. Owned process/binding/wait uncertainty yields unknown6 and retains actual state/slot until confirmed exit. Unexpected implementation failure is failed4. Matching command outcomes across all frontends are required.
private_evolution: Use one typed representation choice instead of contradictory boolean selectors. Explicitly version changed observation/frame/request relationships; preserve historical v1 evidence and label reader compatibility rather than silently accepting a new shape as old. Existing public image.inspect identity, map/fat parameter defaults and outcomes remain compatible. Private source adapters may use explicit wrappers where existing consumers need them; a wrapper is not an admitted SDK ABI.
budgets: Automatic interpretation examines at most two candidates over the same copied table bytes, with at most 65536 mapped units per candidate. Count both candidates conservatively under the existing finite retained/output limits; do not widen read permissions or silently bypass a budget. A bound reached is an accurately diagnosed incomplete observation, not valid mapping. Shared command response remains at most 524288 bytes with explicit detail omissions.
acceptance: Independent generated normal/custom compressed/literal and deliberately ambiguous upcase tables; automatic unique/equivalent/ambiguous selection agrees with full mapping oracles, without additional source reads or normalization.

Actual normal CLI/protocol/GUI/TUI/shell exfat view journeys produce equivalent stable projected observations, while actual process/attempt contexts remain distinct; review is inert and host teardown/source/output preservation verified.

Invalid/conflicting controls and essential/static commands refuse or complete before source access; normal product ignores/rejects fixture controls. Existing map/fat invocation/results and command IDs remain compatible.
Actual corrupt/partial/refused/changed/late/hung/cancelled/invalid reader cases, resource and explicit detail omissions; bounded frontend waits retain live ownership and no replacement is inferred.

Exact native source/build/import/context/tooling/artifact and full relevant product/regression evidence before normal composition admission. Owner/release, unavailable symlink/other platforms/storage and original full0.1.0 remain separate.
automatic_observation_contract: Use a single ExfatUpcaseFormat choice in the private supplied-region request. Existing explicit compressed/literal adapters and root-observation/1 field shape remain available; automatic interpretation uses root-observation/2 with upcase_format=auto. Auto upcase facts bind original bytes/hash, requested_format=auto, a selection of compressed|literal|equivalent|ambiguous|invalid (or pending while evaluation is incomplete), valid and at most two candidate records. Each candidate records format, initialized, evaluated, valid, diagnostic and original decoder details. Unfinished candidates cannot confer validity. Publish mapping_sha256 only for a selected valid map. Compare complete candidate units exactly rather than relying only on hash equality. An explicit decoder refusal is recorded separately from a malformed completed mapping. Retain completed candidate facts if a later candidate exhausts resources; no additional source reads are allowed to choose an encoding. Native and owned v1 worker adapters still request explicit formats until a versioned automatic frame/worker contract is implemented and tested. No public storage ABI or normal product command admission follows from this first stage.
automatic_transport_contract: Continue in existing exfat_file, exfat_snapshot and Windows exfat_worker owners. Add typed ExfatUpcaseFormat file overloads producing exfat-file-capture/2 for every selected format; retain the explicit boolean overloads producing file-capture/1. Typed explicit captures contain root-observation/1; automatic captures contain root-observation/2. The v2 owned snapshot has a single typed format, default Automatic, and strict provider_input schema org.disked.exfat-source-request/2 with mandatory upcase_format=auto|compressed|literal. There is no compressed_upcase field or implicit fallback in that wire request. Worker input/reply/observation/publication and region-frame schemas use /2. Preserve the compiled reader role identity, source/window/epoch/limit bindings, actual PID/creation/code/request and retained-region replay, pre-read expected metadata check and existing exit-only host. The current v2 frame verifier rejects v1/unknown frame/request schemas rather than reinterpreting them. Historical v1 bytes/revisions remain retained; current explicit file wrappers still provide their v1 shape, with no installed/public storage ABI promise. Authentic complete or accurately partial/malformed/ambiguous captures can produce immutable typed snapshots; parent replay derives applicability and observed_stable, so copied flags cannot turn a partial result into authority. Validity of candidate maps never implies a selected map when they differ. Finite payload/input/output budgets and strict normal fixture rejection remain. No automatic transport or frontend admission until actual normal/fault process, source-preservation and negative frame tests pass.
command_service_contract: The prototype exfat view accepts exactly path,view,volume_offset,volume_bytes,upcase_format. volume_bytes is at least512 and the complete window fits signed native63-bit addressing; invalid path text, unknown format, overflow, missing window or unrelated controls refuse2 before invoking the native port. Preserve the existing shared parser diagnostics: missing required parameters use missing_parameter, CLI invalid values or schema relationships use invalid_option_value, and constructed service requests use invalid_parameter. retain_capture is not admitted for exfat until a typed retention-store extension is specified; existing FAT retention stays unchanged. upcase_format defaults auto and explicit selections are recorded. Private ExfatInspectionRequest/Read/Port in runtime/capture/exfat_inspection separates shared validation/projection/outcomes from Windows storage/exfat_reader source/process ownership. The result schema org.disked.exfat-inspection/1 records ordinary-local-file-exfat scope, root-and-active-system applicability, requested format, original complete file/capture digests, context and actual worker, source receipt and bounded observation. root_records projection has at most256items/98304bytes; regions128items/32768bytes; each root/bitmap/upcase chain clusters64items/4096bytes and cells64items/16384bytes. Every projected array records total,returned,omitted and original full-array digest, without new source reads. Complete applicable root/system observations with metadata/binding/replay agreement yield completed0; incomplete observations yield failed4/exfat_capture_incomplete and retain original media diagnostics. Binding/metadata/replay disagreement additionally yields failed4/exfat_source_changed. The known pre-read exfat_file_source_changed refusal is also failed4; path/profile or missing service refusals remain3. Owned worker/wait uncertainty is unknown6 with actual worker state, while the callback and source/session remain owned until confirmed exit. Unexpected errors are failed4/internal_error, response overflow failed4/exfat_report_limit. Responses are at most524288bytes, with the same bounded serialization across CLI,protocol,GUI,TUI,shell. Essential/static commands and inert review do not call the source port. Normal product composition dispatches the existing compiled reader role; fault controls compile only into a separate fixture executable. This is a development image prototype, not physical or public durable storage ABI/release qualification.
